# Card

## Card family

A productive card with a header, a body and actions in its header or
footer. The product-patterns `ProductiveCard` is the upstream.

### Decisions

Action icons are ghost `IconButton`s (sm at the top, md at the bottom),
not raw `__icon` seats; the overflow is an `OverflowMenu`. The footer
renders only when there are bottom actions or a button. `clickZone:
'one'` puts the role, the tab stop and key handling on the root.

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`.

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actionIcons` | `array` | no | Icon seats `{ icon, label, onPress }` - ghost IconButtons, sm at the top, md at the bottom. |
| `actionsPlacement` | `string` | no | One of `top`, `bottom`. Default `bottom`. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The body content. |
| `clickZone` | `string` | no | One of `one`, `two`, `three`. Only `one` puts the role, tab stop and keys on the root. |
| `description` | `string` | no | The description under the title. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the card and removes interaction. |
| `label` | `string` | no | The small label over the title. |
| `onClick` | `function` | no | Called on activation in the click zone. |
| `overflowActions` | `array` | no | `{ label, onPress }` items inside an OverflowMenu. |
| `primaryButtonText` | `string` | no | The primary footer button's label. |
| `secondaryButtonText` | `string` | no | The secondary footer button's label. |
| `onPrimaryButtonClick` | `function` | no | Called by the primary footer button. |
| `onSecondaryButtonClick` | `function` | no | Called by the secondary footer button. |
| `title` | `string` | no | The card title. |
| `titleSize` | `string` | no | One of `default`, `large`. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the card. |
